Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can choose one or the other.
Card Q&A.q: If I have a [Kiriha Aonuma] in play, do I get to choose either "Reveal 4 cards from the top of your deck. Add 2 cards with [Blue Flare] in their traits among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order" or "return 1 [MetalGreymon] from your trash to your hand" for this card's [On Play] effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. In such cases, you add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to add a card to my hand when only 1 card with the [Blue Flare] trait is among the 4 revealed cards?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 2 cards with [Blue Flare] in their traits among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order. If you have a [Kiriha Aonuma] in play, you may return 1 [MetalGreymon] from your trash to your hand instead.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has [Blue Flare] in its traits and your opponent has 2 or more Digimon in play, unsuspend this Digimon.
